control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during a planned shutdown on TH-3240

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control EMBANKMENT_SURVEILLANCE: the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation on TH-3240 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. TH-3240 (tailings thickener) is in service for tailings thickening and decant. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the surveillance of embankments and instrumentation had degraded below its design intent. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 16 September 2020 an incident occurred on TH-3240 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing gravity energy held as suspended load.
